content: GitHub Actions latest majors (GitHub Releases API, 2026-10-31): actions/checkout v7 (v7.0.1, GA June 2026, safer pull_request_target defaults), actions/setup-go v7 (v7.0.0; v6 was node24-based), golangci/golangci-lint-action v9 (v9.3.0; v8+ required for golangci-lint v2). go-ultimate mandates go-version-file: go.mod so the Go version lives only in go.mod.
